video_title: Melo Saw Something SCARY in LeBron's Sixers Debut vs. the Knicks, Wemby's Struggles & More

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on why veteran leadership is often undervalued by NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: As much as they say they want it, as much as they say they need it, they don't want it.
quotes.quote: I do believe that that type of player, that veteran type of leadership, as much as they say they want it, as much as they say they need it, they don't want it. They can talk, oh, the league need vets and they need someone in the locker room and they need, no. Because you don't want that energy. Right? Because it's a different type of energy coming from a younger group. So if you have a vet in there to be on the to be holding the guys accountable at a young age, you're going to be pushed out. That voice is going to become, I don't want to hear that no more, man. I don't. Because you as a young player don't know how to take that. You're not used to that. You don't know how to receive that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the lack of veteran presence in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Over the past decade, it's been the same vets going from team to team to team to team.
quotes.quote: Over the past decade, it's been the same vets going from team to team to team to team. Because now over the more you in that position, the more you you accept, you accept the space that you're in. Okay, I'm in this space, I'm here to do this. I know I'm not going to play, but I'm going to enjoy this. I'm going to take on this role. And that's a special role. And I said that before when I was, I can't take a Thaddeus Young role, right? And I respect somebody like Thaddeus Young to the utmost. But for me to take that role, no, I'm not that's not who I am. I can't accept that. I don't want to accept that role. And if I don't have to accept that role, I'm not going to accept that role.

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: Kazeem Famuyide on why veteran players often retire instead of taking bench roles
quotes.excerpt: Most guys don't have the real world waiting for them afterwards.
quotes.quote: Most guys don't have the real world waiting for them afterwards, as far as like, a Chris Paul, like a Russell Westbrook. He doesn't have the same sort of off-the-court opportunities as a former superstar would. Like a Chris Paul, like a Russell Westbrook, like, you know, those type of guys. So I can see why it would be like, I'd rather retire than take on this role that somebody who's actually suited for it could actually do.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the difficulty of changing your mindset as a veteran player
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to switch your mindset from being that to being that.
quotes.quote: It's hard to switch your mindset from being that to being that. From preparing some a certain way to like now you're preparing a totally different way. If you're you almost have to be stronger preparing for this than you do for preparing for that. That makes sense. Because you essentially you're the second coach. So I got to accept that shit. I got to every day I got to accept it's eating that it's eating at me, my ego, my pride. So I'm bouncing, you know, emotions off of that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the necessity of sacrifice for team success
quotes.excerpt: Whatever move you make, it have to be that move.
quotes.quote: Whatever move you make, it have to be that move. We going to have to make some serious moves. We going to have to make a serious play. They have this year, right? I they got to do it this year. To me, they got to do it this year to get through this year to build the continuity so that you're ready to roll in the next two. Yes. But whatever move you make, it have to be that move. I don't know if that guy will be available.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony sends well wishes to Jalen Hurts and Ben Simmons
quotes.excerpt: I want to send some love out to Jalen Hurts and Ben Simmons, both of them are dealing with some serious stuff

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: I want to send some love out to Jalen Hurts and Ben Simmons, both of them are dealing with some serious stuff right now. We here at 7PM in Brooklyn just want to wish them both a speedy recovery. We never want to see anybody, especially our athletes of any sport, go down like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: I see it. We don't know.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: We don't know. That's a good one.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt details Jalen Hurts' injury and playing status
quotes.excerpt: He reportedly spent the night before the London game in a hospital bed with a blood clot

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: He reportedly spent the night before the London game in a hospital bed with a blood clot that was found. But then he was cleared to play the next day, but he couldn't sleep because of the dangers of the blood clot.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: The doctor told him not to sleep. If you get blood clots when you get on the plane, it also exacerbates it, all that type of stuff. He basically said the blood clot was so severe that if he fell asleep, there was a possibility that he could like severely hurt himself or even worse.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: And he stayed up all night, he played against the Jaguars.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: But this is the thing about it is, you stayed up all night with a blood clot to play in a collision sport.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: And you stressed, and you stressed. So the body is stressed.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: NFL Players Association investigating Jalen Hurts' medical situation
quotes.excerpt: The last thing we saw this morning is that the NFL PA is looking into it

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: The last thing we saw this morning is that the NFL PA is looking into it. They are watching the investigation.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Which they should, because that's what they're there for.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: They have to.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Blood clots becoming a major concern for professional athletes
quotes.excerpt: Blood clots feels like it's becoming so much of a big sports topic over the years

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Blood clots feels like it's becoming so much of a big sports topic over the years. We seen Wemby lose the rest of his season over blood clots, we all know what happened with Chris Bosh, a wrestler by the name of Pac recently suffered from blood clots and passed away.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: We don't know what's happening with Porzingis.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: We don't know what's happening with Porzingis, that could be.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: There's, you know, so these sort of internal injuries, you know what I mean, especially in a sport that's all about we go to tough it out and play.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Eagles organization may face punishment for Jalen Hurts' medical handling
quotes.excerpt: I really think the Eagles organization might have to like go through some real punishment for this

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: I really think the Eagles organization might have to like go through some real punishment for this. I think they're going to they're going to either have to give them some picks or figure out something because like imagine the worst happens.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: This is deeper than picks.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: It's deeper, it's deeper than picks. They're going to they're going to I don't want to LA Clippers them, but like that's a level of potential malpractice.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Medical staff's responsibility to protect players from themselves
quotes.excerpt: The medical staff has a responsibility to stop him from hurting himself

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: At a base level, I would think, you tell me if I'm wrong, as macho as sports is, and not just macho because women push through pain all the time too, the medical staff has a responsibility to stop him from hurting himself.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Yes, so that that yes, okay.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the player-medical staff relationship and trust
quotes.excerpt: You got to have a report, a really good report with your medical staff

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: You got to have a report, a really good report with your medical staff, right? Because I should be able to have that honesty with the medical staff, like, man, I'm feeling this in my calf. Because they're going to ask you, what are you feeling in your calf? Is it here? Is it this? They're going to ask all of those questions. If you're honest with them, you can figure it out.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: That's what I want to know.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Blood thinners and the risks of playing with blood clots
quotes.excerpt: Apparently, the symptoms started the week before and they put him on like blood thinners

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Apparently, the symptoms started the week before and they put him on like blood thinners and stuff, like they tried to.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: That could have did it too.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of medical protocols in sports
quotes.excerpt: We're not going through the same thing we went with Chris Bosh

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: We're not going through the same thing we went with Chris Bosh. That hurt, that hurt a lot of people. That hurt him. So why would we want to keep doing that? We could learn from that. Let's get better at that.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: His life is threatening, dog. This is not an ankle, this is not an ACL, this is not some, oh, you got to rehab this, this is time.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero on Ben Simmons' Achilles injury
quotes.excerpt: News broke that he tore his Achilles, awful, done for the season

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: News broke that he tore his Achilles, awful, done for the season.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: No, that's that's I don't I don't wish that on nobody.
